mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_import_item (batch_id, user_id, original_input, bvid, status, fail_reason, retry_count, video_id, create_time, start_time, finish_time) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{userId}, #{originalInput}, #{bvid}, #{status}, #{failReason}, #{retryCount}, #{videoId}, #{createTime}, #{startTime}, #{finishTime})

INSERT IGNORE INTO video_import_item (batch_id, user_id, original_input, bvid, status, fail_reason, retry_count, video_id, create_time, start_time, finish_time) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{userId}, #{originalInput}, #{bvid}, 'QUEUED', NULL, #{retryCount}, NULL, #{createTime}, NULL, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM video_import_item WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM video_import_item WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE video_import_item SET status = 'RUNNING', start_time = #{startTime}, finish_time = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM video_import_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND bvid = #{bvid} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE video_import_item failed_item LEFT JOIN video_import_item active_item ON active_item.user_id = failed_item.user_id AND active_item.bvid = failed_item.bvid AND active_item.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND active_item.id != failed_item.id SET failed_item.status = 'QUEUED', failed_item.start_time = NULL, failed_item.finish_time = NULL, failed_item.fail_reason = NULL, failed_item.video_id = NULL, failed_item.retry_count = failed_item.retry_count + 1 WHERE failed_item.batch_id = #{batchId} AND failed_item.status = 'FAILED' AND active_item.id IS NULL
UPDATE video_import_item SET status = 'QUEUED', start_time = NULL WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
